proposition: Munshaʾāt letter 16, from Ibn Turka in Isfahan to Shāhrukh by way of Yazd, was to be delivered by Niʿmat Allāh Valī in reply to Shāhrukh's summons; it conveys admiration for the newly ascendant Shāhrukh and promises he will soon attend the court.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka to Shāhrukh, Munshaʾāt-i Turka letter 16
mediation.where: TMN/M f. 148a; TMN/MS pp. 11-12; TMN/D pp. 170-73
mediation.note: a petition to the ruler who had summoned him: written to be well received, not to state private conviction
